title: The AI Builder Roadmap — educational poster
caption:
Most people learning AI in 2026 are collecting tricks. Builders follow a path.

Here's the 10-stage roadmap — zero to shipping real things with AI 👇

1. AI foundations — how models actually think
2. Prompt engineering — the skill that compounds
3. Your AI toolkit — the right tool per job
4. AI-assisted coding — ship without a CS degree
5. APIs & integration — wire AI into real apps
6. Your first agent — AI that acts, not just chats
7. Memory & context — why most agents break
8. Workflow automation — chain tasks end to end
9. Ship a real project — something people actually use
10. Deploy & scale — prototype to product

You don't need all of it on day one. You need stage 1 — then the next one. The people who'll be irreplaceable next year aren't the ones who know the most prompts. They're the ones who can BUILD.

Save this. Start at stage 1 today.

Comment "BUILD" and I'll DM you the full step-by-step roadmap — the exact tools and first move for every stage.

Disclaimer: shared for educational purposes only. AI tools change fast — adapt the path to your own goals.
